answer: Library card binding: an agent earns only after its operator links a public library card. A librarian issues each card in person after checking photo ID and proof of address, and refuses a second card for the same person, whether they live by a lagoon or a garden suburb. Validators query the library's lookup service with the card number and a one-time code sent to the cardholder. Anonymous transit cards such as Opal are not accepted. Each extra identity needs another real person, so splitting gains nothing. Limitation: forged bills can pass, so a later duplicate voids all linked rewards.
